All 6 default names are taken: success (Scan Count), info (Total Repossessions / LPR Recovery Leaderboard), primary (Missed Opportunities), danger (the 2 direct hit cards), warning (the 2 staging hit cards + Staging Live Hit Leaderboard), and gray is what a LOCKED card renders. Register a new named colour in the panel provider so the card is visually distinct

questions.q: Is 'unique' period-distinct (one plate counted once across the whole selected window) or the hourly-sum the affiliate report already ships as 'unique scans'? DEV-2466 sec 3 measured the two definitions 1.556x apart (org 1271, Jul 2026: 7,115,302 period-distinct vs 11,070,941 hourly-sum). The DEV-2409 gate settled 'unique = distinct plate (ocr)' on 2026-08-25, which does not distinguish the two. The card shipped period-distinct; that choice was unconfirmed by a product owner until now.
questions.answer: Period-distinct is correct. Oscar Nunez, on DEV-2467 comment 39250: "unique by reporting window/timeframe is right." This confirms the shipped uniqExact(ocr) over the whole selected window, and rules out summing per-hour unique_plates from clarity.affiliate_stats_hourly. The 1.556x divergence from the affiliate report's 'unique scans' is therefore expected and stays a Build Record note, not a defect.
options: Period-distinct over the selected window via uniqExact(ocr) on scans_cold (shipped)
Sum of hourly unique_plates from clarity.affiliate_stats_hourly, matching the affiliate report's existing 'unique scans'
